title: Tim Cook becomes Apple Executive Chairman; John Ternus becomes CEO
summary: Apple's board-approved leadership transition takes effect: John Ternus, SVP of Hardware Engineering, becomes Apple's CEO and joins the board, while Tim Cook moves to executive chairman.

title: PostgreSQL 19 expected to release
summary: PostgreSQL 19 is expected to reach general availability, following feature freeze on 2026-04-08 and a beta period starting in May 2026.

title: CISA KEV remediation deadline: MLflow SSRF (CVE-2026-64849)
summary: CISA added CVE-2026-64849, a critical unauthenticated MLflow SSRF vulnerability under active exploitation for cloud credential theft, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on August 19, 2026; federal agencies face a two-week remediation window under BOD 26-04, expected around September 2, 2026.

title: JDK 27 general availability
summary: OpenJDK's JDK 27 reaches general availability after entering Rampdown Phase 2. The release makes G1 the default garbage collector in all environments and adds post-quantum TLS key exchange.

title: Meta Connect
summary: Meta's annual AR/VR/AI conference runs at its Menlo Park campus, opening with a keynote from Mark Zuckerberg on day one and developer-focused sessions on day two.

title: OpenAI DevDay 2026
summary: OpenAI holds its annual developer conference at Fort Mason in San Francisco, opening with a keynote on the platform roadmap followed by technical sessions, demos, and workshops. The keynote will be livestreamed free to the public.
